CHEM 1210.title: Principles of Chemistry I
CHEM 1210.prereqText: MATH 1080 , MATH 1050 , MATH 1055 or any higher MATH course with a C- or better, or appropriate placement scores for MATH 1060 or higher. Also, it is highly recommended to have prior chemistry experience in high school or in CHEM 1010

CHEM 2320.prereqText: CHEM 2310 & CHEM 2315 with a C- or higher
